You're a clean-energy founder. You're spending 40 hours a week on compliance reports instead of building product.

GreenLane connects to your existing systems, generates regulator-ready reports automatically, and gives you back the four-day work-week your investors thought you already had. The first report runs in under an hour. The next thousand run themselves.

Used by founders at 80+ clean-energy startups · SOC 2 Type II · Built on the same tools your auditors already use
The problem we built this for
You did not start a clean-energy company to write reports.

If you are running a clean-energy startup right now, you already know the math. There are 17 active reporting frameworks. Three of them changed last quarter. Your customers are asking for one. Your auditor wants another. Your largest investor's ESG team has invented a third.

So instead of shipping product, you and your operations lead spend two weeks every quarter pulling numbers from seven systems into a spreadsheet that nobody trusts, that the regulator cannot read, and that becomes obsolete the moment the next framework lands. The work is real. The work is critical. The work is also, by every measure that matters to your runway, a tax.

We built GreenLane because we did this work for two years inside a clean-energy company and it nearly killed the company. The product you are about to read about is the one we wish we had had on day one.

content.heading: The problem
content.subheading: Compliance is not a feature. It is a tax on focus.

props.title: 1. Connect
props.description: Connect your data sources in under twenty minutes — utility meters, SCADA exports, accounting, payroll, the lot. We use the same read-only credentials your auditor already has. Nothing leaves your perimeter without your sign-off.

props.title: 2. Automate
props.description: GreenLane maps your data once, against the seven frameworks that actually matter for your stage and sector, and keeps the mapping current as the rules change. The next quarter's report is mostly written by the time the quarter ends.

props.title: 3. Ship
props.description: Review what we drafted. Make the three or four edits only a human should make. Export the regulator-ready PDF, the auditor-ready ledger, and the investor-ready summary. File. Get back to building.

content.heading: How GreenLane works
content.subheading: Three steps. Once. The fourth one is your weekend.
